component.name: Glass Gallery
component.summary: See and tune glass-lib's refracting glass

description.p: The demo and test bench of glass-lib, a GTK 4 and libadwaita library for refracting, Liquid Glass–style glass over an app's own content.

ul.li: Photos: a grid scrolling under glass bars, in the same frame
Playground: panels to drag and resize over test patterns
Controls: switches, sliders, fused buttons, menus and dialogs of glass
Tabs: a tab bar and a search field that morphs out of a button
Lab: every optical parameter and the tint, live

description.p: This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.
